investment_theses.thesis: Long BTC vs. short SPY: Bitcoin capitulation ($76K, $1B+ liquidations) is oversold relative to macro Fed-cut tailwinds, while equities face consensus risk if jobless duration signals structural unemployment rise.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Over $1B bullish bets liquidated; BTC flatlined under $76K
CNBC: 27-week jobless duration (decade high outside pandemic) vs. jobs beat (165K >> 65K estimate)
BBC: Post-midterm AI sell-off reversing as investors digest Democrat control = regulatory clarity
investment_theses.counter_view: Jobless duration data may be lagged; actual unemployed workers may find jobs faster in 2026 as Fed cuts rates and credit loosens—SPY could rally harder than BTC if macro inflection is real.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perps (e.g., Binance BTCUSDT perpetual), short SPY (or sell call spreads) 90-day horizon

investment_theses.thesis: Long ETH/BTC ratio: AI sell-off overshot Ethereum as a compute play; institutional capital returning post-election clarity will rebalance portfolio allocations, favoring Ethereum's app-layer upside vs. macro-only BTC narrative.
supporting_signals: BBC: AI stock recovery already underway post-midterm clarity
CoinDesk: Spot ETF flows suggest no macro help (yet), but ETH oversold relative to BTC on compute rotation
CNBC: OpenAI CFO committed to capex—infrastructure demand for Ethereum L2s and staking will follow
investment_theses.counter_view: If Fed stays hawkish despite jobless duration risk, BTC's store-of-value narrative outperforms ETH's utility narrative; regulatory clarity (Democrats) could also penalize Ethereum DeFi.
investment_theses.expression: Long ETH/BTC perpetual ratio (inverse BTCETH), or buy ETH perps, sell BTC perps in 2:1 notional
